title: SwiftSdkConfig
description: Validation schema for the SWIFT Alliance Gateway SDK configuration file.

gateway_url.description: HTTPS endpoint of the SWIFT Alliance Gateway or Alliance Lite2 instance.

institution_bic.description: 8- or 11-character BIC of the connecting institution (ISO 9362).

service_bureau_bic.description: Optional BIC of the Service Bureau providing connectivity. Empty string if direct connection.

cert_path.description: File-system path to the SWIFT PKI client certificate (PEM format).

key_path.description: File-system path to the private key matching the PKI certificate (PEM format).

lau_key.description: HMAC-SHA256 secret for LAU header signing. Must be at least 32 characters.

environment.description: Deployment environment. Controls base-URL resolution and logging verbosity.

retry_attempts.description: Number of automatic retry attempts on transient (5xx / network) errors.
